episodes.title: The MAGA Bubble: Why It’s Harder To Leave Than You Think
episodes.description:
I was MAGA through and through — I went to the RNC with my baby on my hip. How do smart, loyal people get pulled into a loyalty cycle that feels like family, faith, and purpose?

I'm Tami Green — been there, now I coach it. In this video I share my I was MAGA cult story and break down the 7-stage coercive control cycle I lived at home with a mini Trump wannabe — loyalty tests, spiritual fear, savior story, isolation, and the paranoia bubble — and how that same pattern maps to cult of personality, authoritarianism, and cult psychology.

You are not crazy for staying loyal. That's gaslighting + trauma bonding + emotional abuse inside a closed system. When isolated minds can't reality test, you lose trust in yourself. Recovery — narcissistic abuse recovery, healing a trauma bond, rebuilding after psychological abuse and cptsd — starts with small self-directed steps to trust yourself again.

I cover political psychology, psychology of politics, gaslighting in politics, coercive control in society, psychology of power, and love bombing as the entry point, plus how dark psychology loyalty and the psychology of MAGA keep people stuck.

This video is educational and is not therapy. If you are unsafe, please reach out to a trusted professional or local resources.
